verdict.rationale: Helicone's Prompts feature explicitly supports versioning ('Track every change, compare versions, and rollback instantly') and production deployment without code changes ('Test and deploy prompt changes instantly without rebuilding or redeploying your application' by referencing a prompt ID in the AI Gateway). This directly matches the story of versioning and deploying prompt changes without shipping code. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration specifically of the prompt-versioning workflow (community evidence covers observability/logging, not prompt deployment) and detail on rollback UX.
